title.value: Build an invoice platform that flags anomalies

introduction.value: A non-developer used Replit and Claude to build an invoice platform that flags high-value invoices, sends payment reminders and catches duplicates; on 130 demo invoices it found four anomalies.

method.value: Nikhil Thamma, a business analytics graduate, prompted his way through building Documind in Replit. Uploaded invoices go to Claude, which extracts the fields into a SQLite database. Background rules then flag high-value invoices, send due-date reminders and catch duplicates. He added a minimum of three invoices per vendor and low/medium/high confidence scores to cut false alerts.

outcome.value: On 130 simulated coffee-shop invoices ($91,796 total), it caught four anomalies, including an $875 duplicate and a 60% bean price rise. False positives fell from 40% to about 15%.

notes.value: It's a single-user MVP: extraction accuracy is about 95% on clean invoices but 60–70% on handwritten or poor scans, and there's no human-review step.

source_text.body:
Build an invoice platform that flags anomalies
A non-developer used Replit and Claude to build an invoice platform that flags high-value invoices, sends payment reminders and catches duplicates; on 130 demo invoices it found four anomalies.
Done with
RA
Replit Agent
CC
Claude Code
What they did
Nikhil Thamma, a business analytics graduate, prompted his way through building Documind in Replit. Uploaded invoices go to Claude, which extracts the fields into a SQLite database. Background rules then flag high-value invoices, send due-date reminders and catch duplicates. He added a minimum of three invoices per vendor and low/medium/high confidence scores to cut false alerts.
How it went
On 130 simulated coffee-shop invoices ($91,796 total), it caught four anomalies, including an $875 duplicate and a 60% bean price rise. False positives fell from 40% to about 15%.
Worth knowing
It's a single-user MVP: extraction accuracy is about 95% on clean invoices but 60–70% on handwritten or poor scans, and there's no human-review step.
Try it yourself
with
Replit Agent
Copy prompt
Build an invoice tracking app that loads invoices from [CSV or sample data], flags high-value invoices over [threshold], catches duplicates, and drafts payment reminders. Load about 100 demo invoices and show me what it flags. Do not send any reminders; show me each draft first and wait for my approval.
Original source: https://medium.com/@nthamma1/i-built-an-ai-powered-invoice-platform-on-replit-using-prompts-heres-what-happened-44e35c3d5c31
